entries.author: assistant
entries.summary: Admin edit-user modal: consolidate two Save buttons into one
entries.context: Original split (a small 'Save scope' + big 'Save') was a bad reading of the enterprise 'removals apply immediately' pattern from the research. In practice it created a footgun: changing both roles and scope, then clicking the big Save, silently lost the scope edit.
changed: frontend/app/admin/page.tsx — EditUserPanel.save() now fires updateAdminUser + updateAdminUserScope in parallel via Promise.all. Small 'Save scope' button removed. savingScope state removed. The scope card footer is now a status line, not an action.

sign in with the new password -> succeeds
reuse the same token -> 401 'not valid or has expired'
invariants_established: The admin never sees the chosen password; they see only the activation URL.
Only SHA-256 of the token is persisted; the raw token cannot be recovered from the DB.
Tokens are single-use, 24-hour, and one active per user.
Reset breaks the existing password immediately (before the invitee opens the link).
prototype_notes: Activation link is shared out of band (copy from admin UI). SMTP delivery is future work — Q-001 remains open.
No rate limiting on POST /activate yet.

entries.author: assistant
entries.summary: Compliance audit trail extended to deal + hedge write paths — Compliance page now shows business activity, not just admin actions

changed: backend/app/services/deal_service.py — record() now writes audit_event action='deal.recorded' with counterparty_id, instrument, principal_pence, tenor_months, rate_bp, legal_entity_id, override_reason, failed_checks
backend/app/api/deals.py — approve_deal endpoint writes audit_event action='deal.approved' with approved_role + required_approver

backend/app/api/fx.py — initiate_hedge writes audit_event action='hedge.initiated' with counterparty, currency, sell_amount_minor, gbp_expected_pence, tenor_months, forward_rate, legal_entity_id, exposure_ids, hedge_link_ids

entries.rationale: Phase A-D wrote audit_event for admin actions only. Compliance page (ADR-0016) is meant to be the full activity trail. Wiring deal.recorded / deal.approved / hedge.initiated closes the gap so a compliance officer can reconstruct the business day, not just the admin day.
smoke_target: Propose a deal -> GET /compliance/activity?action=deal.recorded returns row with the failed_checks + override_reason
Approve that deal -> action=deal.approved row with approved_role
Initiate a hedge -> action=hedge.initiated row with counterparty + hedge_link_ids
